methodology_semantics.scope: Applies only to explicitly supplied NORMAL_IMPULSE scope.
methodology_semantics.direction: Direction must be explicitly UP or DOWN.
methodology_semantics.wave2_retracement_extreme: Caller supplies the Wave 2 retracement extreme.
methodology_semantics.up_violation: UP violates only if the Wave 2 extreme is less than the Wave 1 origin.
methodology_semantics.down_violation: DOWN violates only if the Wave 2 extreme is greater than the Wave 1 origin.
methodology_semantics.comparison: No tolerance, epsilon, or fuzzy comparison is applied.
methodology_semantics.satisfaction_scope: Satisfying P004 does not validate the entire candidate.
methodology_semantics.unresolved_scope: Unresolved states are not candidate-validity judgments.

protection_status: Development logical baseline only; no physical immutability, ACL protection, signing, or process isolation is claimed.
